title: retake.json
description: A Retake project's configuration. Every field is optional.

$schema.description: The URL of the schema the file is written against, for editors. Optional; a file is read against this Retake's schema whatever it names.

bundleID.description: The app's bundle ID. Without it, the bundle ID comes from the app `retake install` last embedded.

build.description: How `retake install` builds the app when it isn't given one: a scheme, or a command of the project's own.

oneOf.description: Retake builds a scheme with xcodebuild, for iOS devices, with its build products in the project's build folder.

workspace.description: The workspace holding the scheme, needed only when the directory holds more than one. Relative to the directory holding retake.json.

xcodeproj.description: The project holding the scheme, needed only when the directory holds more than one. Relative to the directory holding retake.json.

configuration.description: The build configuration, which must be development-signed for the device.

allowProvisioningUpdates.description: Lets xcodebuild register the device and update profiles on your team.

optimize.description: Builds with the compiler's optimisation on, Swift at -O and C at -Os, whatever the configuration says, so the app runs as fast as its users see it.

oneOf.description: The project's own command builds the app: for builds one xcodebuild call can't make. It's run with /bin/sh in the project's directory, with the device's UDID in RETAKE_DEVICE_UDID.

command.description: The command that builds the app.

app.description: The .app the command leaves. Relative to the directory holding retake.json.

device.description: The device commands use when none is named: an alias, a UDID, or a device's name.

defaultSet.description: The set a scene starts on when it names none, and the one `retake compose` gives a new scene.

output.description: Where takes and cuts go. Relative to the directory holding retake.json.
